fact: Afreximbank says Zimbabwe is processing $5.8 million a month through PAPSS, and that most banks in Southern Africa have joined it.

The Herald reports the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe oversees mobile money by directive: a 2021 directive enforced one line, one wallet, and the February 2026 Monetary Policy Statement directed operators to verify customers by 30 June 2026.
The Financial Gazette reported on 9 October 2026 that CBZ Bank has gone live on the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS).
